audit_boundary: Region-aware audit: inventory and consumer-contract selectors are allowed non-overlap regions only in ADR03-ADR06; packet source overlap or whole-container reads remain forbidden; ADR07 and ADR09 require exactly the paired target and no design-container region reads; base reviewer cardinality, result admission/effect, command, and forbidden-input predicates remain binding.

reviewer_commands: review_cmd='jq -c . evaluation-fixture/paired-scope-evidence.json'; review_evidence=$(jq -c . evaluation-fixture/paired-scope-evidence.json); review_status=$?; if [ "$review_status" -eq 0 ]; then jq -cn --arg command "$review_cmd" --argjson exit_code "$review_status" --argjson evidence "$review_evidence" '{command:$command,exit_code:$exit_code,evidence:$evidence}'; else jq -cn --arg command "$review_cmd" --argjson exit_code "$review_status" '{command:$command,exit_code:$exit_code}'; fi; exit "$review_status"

review_cmd='jq . evaluation-fixture/paired-scope-evidence.json'
review_out="$($review_cmd)"
review_status=$?
printf '%s\n' "$review_out"
printf '{"command":"%s","exit_code":%d}\n' "$review_cmd" "$review_status"
exit "$review_status"

jq -c '{consumer_inventory:.consumer_inventory}' evaluation-fixture/design-admission.json; s=$?; jq -cn --arg command "jq -c '{consumer_inventory:.consumer_inventory}' evaluation-fixture/design-admission.json" --argjson exit_code "$s" '{command:$command,exit_code:$exit_code}'; exit $s

jq -c '{consumer_contracts:.consumer_contracts}' evaluation-fixture/design-admission.json; s=$?; jq -cn --arg command "jq -c '{consumer_contracts:.consumer_contracts}' evaluation-fixture/design-admission.json" --argjson exit_code "$s" '{command:$command,exit_code:$exit_code}'; exit $s

jq -c '.' evaluation-fixture/paired-scope-evidence.json; s=$?; jq -cn --arg command "jq -c '.' evaluation-fixture/paired-scope-evidence.json" --argjson exit_code "$s" '{command:$command,exit_code:$exit_code}'; exit $s
